These projects bring together field studies, non-model resources and reproducible analysis around environmental stress and biological organisation.

## Reproducible eco-omics and field ecotoxicology
::: {.project-grid}
::: {.project-card}
### EchoGO

**Problem:** Functional interpretation can depend on the annotation resource used, especially for non-model organisms.

**Contribution:** An R framework for annotation-context-aware interpretation after differential-expression analysis, anchored to the target experimental enrichment.

**Programme link:** Supports transparent and transferable interpretation across non-model eco-omics.

R · RNA-seq · GO enrichment · non-model organisms · reproducibility

[GitHub](https://github.com/miloes114/EchoGo)  
[Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17660708)
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Holtemme Gammarus Ecotoxicogenomics

**Problem:** Relating environmental micropollutant mixtures to molecular responses in wild *Gammarus pulex* across a river gradient.

**Contribution:** A reproducible analysis integrating environmental chemistry, transcriptome-wide structure, differential expression, functional interpretation and gene-network analysis.

**Programme link:** Connects a real-world stress gradient with molecular and network-level responses.

field ecotoxicology · RNA-seq · environmental chemistry · WGCNA · research compendium

[GitHub](https://github.com/miloes114/holtemme-gammarus-ecotoxicogenomics)
:::
:::

## Non-model organism workflows and resources
::: {.project-grid}
::: {.project-card}
### Cottus Genomics

**Problem:** Building genome and transcriptome resources for European sculpins.

**Contribution:** A reproducible workflow combining genome annotation, RNA evidence, de novo transcriptomics, HPC execution, validation gates and release-oriented provenance.

**Programme link:** Develops reusable molecular resources for non-model aquatic organisms.

genomics · BRAKER · Trinity · HPC · non-model organisms

:::

::: {.project-card}
### Skåne Environmental Metagenomics

**Problem:** Characterising microbial genomes and environmental viruses across spatially structured metagenomes.

**Contribution:** A Snakemake/HPC workflow across seven sites, including MAG recovery, vOTU catalogues, taxonomy, quantification and evidence-aware virus–host linkage.

**Programme link:** Extends my work into microbial and viral community organisation, environmental metagenomics and host–virus ecological structure.

metagenomics · viromics · MAGs · Snakemake · HPC

:::

::: {.project-card}
### Zebrafish Exposure Transcriptomics

**Problem:** Comparing molecular responses across two chemical-exposure experiments in zebrafish larvae.

**Contribution:** A reproducible RNA-seq workflow integrating differential expression, target enrichment, annotation-context interpretation, KEGG analysis and mechanism-focused synthesis.

**Programme link:** Adds a comparative experimental exposure context to my work with environmental stress responses.

zebrafish · RNA-seq · DESeq2 · functional genomics

:::
:::

## Emerging programme
::: {.project-grid}
::: {.project-card}
### TROPECO-OMICS / Hi-SGH

**Question:** How does biological coordination change as environmental stress increases, and when might compensation give way to loss of resilience?

**Status:** Proposal under evaluation.

**Programme link:** Hi-SGH provides a testable framework for studying cross-layer coordination, compensation and resilience along real-world stress gradients.

multi-omics · holobiont · field gradients · resilience · systems ecology
:::
:::

## Project philosophy

Across these projects, I preserve data provenance, connect analytical outputs to primary evidence and document the decisions that shape biological interpretation.
